messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident created for tenant=AtlasFin on dedicated-cluster=d-az2-07. Symptoms: sustained tail latency > 1.5s P99, increased 5xx rates (502/503). Trigger: reserved_pool_qos_throttle > 80%

pagerduty: Page fired to on-call: maria (eng-oncall). Incident ID PD-72318. Priority: P1.

maria: Acked PD-72318 :white_check_mark: I'm on it. Starting triage — checking kvcache and reserved pool metrics.

raj: I see spikes in kv_cache_evictions around 13:41 UTC, eviction rate up x4 vs baseline. Likely hot-prefix churn. Metrics: `kv_evictions/s` from 12 -> 48. Also CPU on d-az2-07-gpu-3 jumped to 92%.

maria: Copy. Running quick query on router logs for 502s:
```
kubectl -n prod logs router-d-az2-07 --since=5m | grep AtlasFin | tail -n 100
```
Results show many `kvcache miss->fallback` messages and backend queue depth rising.

kim: If KV cache is evicting hot prefixes, we'll see latency as requests fallback to full model path. Can we bump reserved pool size temporarily or enable burst nodes?

maria: Checked reserved capacity: pool AtlasFin-reserved has 1 spare node in standby but autoscale policy is strict. Trying manual scale:
```
rmctl scale reserved AtlasFin-reserved --add-nodes 2 --force
```
This will add 2 nodes, estimated warm-up 90s. Kicking it now.

sre-lead: Heads up — if we scale, cost commit increases; okay for mitigation. Also, consider clearing local KV caches to stop thrash while new nodes warm.

raj: On cache clearing: we can issue an eviction pause for prefix sampling for 30s to reduce churn. Command: `modelctl cache pause-eviction --tenant AtlasFin --duration 30s`

maria: Issued `cache pause-eviction` at 13:45:12 UTC. Confirming API responded 200.

kim: New nodes provisioned, join in progress. Provider shows 2 instances `d-az2-07-gpu-8` & `d-az2-07-gpu-9` in provisioning.

maria: Early signs: tail latency P99 dropped from 1.6s -> 0.9s after pause + node join, error rate dropping. Still seeing intermittent 502s though. Continuing logs.

pagerduty: PD-72318 updated: acknowledged by maria. Escalation policy not yet triggered.

raj: Observed a noisy client sending many unique long prompts that blow KV cache keyspace. Could be a bad customer job. Tenant-side pattern: many unique session IDs with large context lengths.

maria: Reached out to AtlasFin via support channel: "we're seeing elevated 5xx from your reserved cluster, investigating infrastructure mitigation; might ask you to pause heavy workloads for next ~15m."

kim: Suggest applying a temporary rate-limit on tenant route to protect cluster while we stabilize: `routerctl limit set AtlasFin 200rps` — will that impact latency-sensitive traffic?

sre-lead: Approved temporary 200rps limit. Maria please apply and ping when done.

maria: Applied rate limit at 13:48:02 UTC. Confirmed via router metrics that ingress dropped from 1300rps -> ~180rps for AtlasFin. Noisy job visibly reduced.

raj: After rate limit + cache pause + scale, evictions back to baseline and 5xxs reduced to near-zero. P99 stable ~0.75s.

maria: Monitoring for 10 more minutes. Notifying oncall rotation: raj will stay for handoff in 20m, Kim to follow up on autoscale policy tweak so this doesn't happen again.

kim: We'll relax autoscale policy for AtlasFin to allow 2-minute aggressive scale for spike windows and add a cache eviction guard to avoid thrash. Filing infra ticket INFRA-1249.

sre-lead: Thanks team. Maria — please update PD with status and close when stable. Raj — good candidate for a post-incident note describing tenant-side root cause (noisy client).

maria: Updated PD-72318: mitigations applied (pause-eviction, manual scale + rate limit). Customer notified. Leaving incident open for monitoring.

maria: 13:56:30 UTC — 20m after mitigation: metrics look stable, 5xxs == baseline, P99 ~0.7s. Will start handoff to raj for cool-down.

raj: Taking over monitoring. I'll keep PD open for 30m then close if no regressions.

pagerduty: PD-72318 status changed to "acknowledged" -> "monitoring" by raj.

incident-bot: Reminder: create postmortem draft if incident exceeds 30m or customer impact > 10% of requests. Logging incident notes to #incidents.

maria: Thanks. Quick notes added to #incidents: `AtlasFin - KV cache eviction due to high unique prompt cardinality; mitigations: pause eviction, manual scale, temporary rate limit; infra follow-up INFRA-1249; eng follow-up: contact AtlasFin to advise workload shaping`. :thumbsup:

raj: Leaving thread open for another 30m. If anything reappears I'll escalate.

kim: I'll start the autoscale config change in staging and coordinate rollout with SRE.

maria: Closing my shift — handoff complete. :wave:

raj: Acknowledged handoff. Subscribing to alerts for this tenant.

pagerduty: PD-72318 will auto-close after 30 minutes of no new alerts.

incident-bot: Incident thread archived to eng-oncall channel history.
